about.name: Dayan Candamil
about.intro: Dayan Candamil advises families, family offices and private investors on the placement of capital in the United Arab Emirates and the wider Gulf. As Associate Partner at BlackOak Real Estate, she leads the firm's international markets and structures cross-border investment between Latin America, the United States, the GCC, Morocco and West Africa, across prime plots, luxury residences and branded developments. Mandates begin at USD 5 million.
about.body1: Dayan is credited with bringing significant private capital to the region and is regarded as a trusted bridge between Latin America and the Gulf. She has introduced some of Latin America's most distinguished family offices to the UAE. Her work includes major Aldar transactions on Yas and Saadiyat Islands, alongside prime plots in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Her residential placements include Mandarin Oriental Residences, Four Seasons Residences DIFC, Emaar and Meraas. Each was concluded for clients who value discretion as highly as performance.
about.body2: Her greatest value lies beyond the transaction. Dayan understands the Gulf's culture, its relationships and how decisions are truly made there. For international clients, that understanding is the difference between entering a market and being welcomed into it.
about.body3: Born in Colombia, Dayan read law in São Paulo, art history in San Francisco and luxury brand management at the London College of Fashion. Her career has taken her through Key Biscayne, Panama City, Miami, Marrakech and Dubai. She works alongside international counsel and family offices, so that every entry into the region is orderly and well considered.

advisory.title: Cross-Border Investment
advisory.body: Structured capital pathways from the Americas to the Gulf.
advisory.intro: Dayan opens a considered path into the Gulf for private wealth from Latin America and the United States. Each placement is structured from first allocation to final title, connecting family offices and private investors directly with the most sought-after assets in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
advisory.point1Body: Guiding significant allocations from established family offices in the Americas into prime UAE real estate.
advisory.point2Body: Orchestrating multi-jurisdictional acquisitions across master developments and off-market plots, in concert with international counsel.
advisory.point3Body: Reconciling international legal and financial frameworks with the customs of the Gulf, so that capital is not merely placed but properly received.

privateClients.title: Private Clients & Family Offices
privateClients.intro: Dayan represents private clients and family offices on the buy side. Every mandate is handled with complete confidentiality, and client identities and transaction details stay private.
privateClients.point1Body: Sourcing and negotiating off-market acquisitions of branded residences, private estates and plots, in complete confidence.
privateClients.point2Body: Coordinating with international counsel on family relocation, residency, and company formation within the DIFC and ADGM.
privateClients.point3Body: Assembling real estate holdings across Dubai and Abu Dhabi with a view to preservation, protection and enduring yield.

transactions.title: Prime & Off-Market Assets
transactions.body: Land, residences and rare opportunities, privately held.
transactions.intro: The most desirable assets in the Emirates seldom reach the open market. Dayan sources them through long-standing private relationships and presents only those of genuine strategic merit.
transactions.point1Body: Acquisition of residential, commercial and mixed-use plots in the most coveted districts of Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
transactions.point2Body: Completed and off-plan residences in the region's most exclusive enclaves, operated by the world's leading hospitality houses.
transactions.point3Body: Quiet portfolio sales, bulk acquisitions and time-sensitive situations that call for decisive capital and exacting execution.

developers.title: Market-Entry Strategy
developers.body: For developers seeking capital in Latin America and Africa.
developers.intro: Dayan advises Gulf developers on presenting their projects to private capital in Latin America and Africa, shaping positioning, pricing and distribution through relationships built over two decades.
developers.point1Body: Shaping each development's narrative to the cultural and financial expectations of Latin American and African family offices.
developers.point2Body: Calibrating pricing and payment structures to the preferences of international buyers.
developers.point3Body: Opening direct access to qualified private wealth through select placement channels across multiple jurisdictions.

marrakech.title: Marrakech & North African Estates
marrakech.body: A private bridge between Morocco and the Gulf.
marrakech.intro: Dayan presents a select collection of Marrakech estates and developments to buyers across the GCC, acting as a discreet intermediary between distinguished Moroccan owners and Gulf capital.
marrakech.point1Body: Exceptional private estates and historic riads, presented privately to ultra-high-net-worth families in the GCC.
marrakech.point2Body: Representing Moroccan master-planned and hospitality projects seeking Gulf investment, joint ventures or portfolio acquisitions.
marrakech.point3Body: Navigating the regulatory, currency and ownership frameworks between Morocco and the GCC, alongside counsel in both jurisdictions.

houseOfCandamil.title: House of Candamil
houseOfCandamil.intro: Founded in Dubai in 2020, House of Candamil is Dayan's atelier of collectible design. It is built on enduring partnerships with master artisans in Colombia and Morocco, preserving ancestral techniques and refining them for contemporary residences of distinction. Its work has received recognition from the governments of both Morocco and Colombia.
houseOfCandamil.point1Body: Sustaining traditional craft through direct partnerships with master makers, so that it becomes modern collectible design.
houseOfCandamil.point2Body: Furniture, architectural elements and curated objects made to order, each with documented provenance.
houseOfCandamil.point3Body: Private gallery collaborations and curated interiors for residences, hospitality and select retail.

familyOffice.title: Family Office Allocation
familyOffice.objective: To diversify multi-generational wealth into dollar-pegged assets in the Gulf.
familyOffice.approach: Acting under a strict confidentiality mandate, Dayan identified off-market plots in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. She coordinated with international counsel to establish holding structures within the DIFC and ADGM, and conducted the acquisition from start to finish without any public listing.
familyOffice.outcome: A protected multi-asset portfolio, composed for preservation, steady yield and orderly succession.

estateCommission.title: Private Estate & Atelier Commission
estateCommission.objective: To acquire a landmark estate in Marrakech and furnish it to the highest standard of provenance.
estateCommission.approach: Dayan led the private, off-market acquisition in complete confidence. She then engaged House of Candamil's master artisans in Colombia and Morocco to create bespoke furniture, architectural elements and collectible pieces for the residence.
estateCommission.outcome: A turnkey legacy estate of lasting value, both as an investment and as a work of culture.

reviews.heading: On Trustpilot
reviews.body: Quoted from Dayan's public Trustpilot profile.

terraine.name: Terraine Tuico
terraine.title: Trusted and Highly Recommended
terraine.text:
I'm truly grateful to have had Dayan as my real estate agent. From the very beginning, she was incredibly patient, attentive, and genuinely listened to what I was looking for.

What I appreciated most was that I never felt pressured or rushed into making a decision. She took the time to explain everything clearly, answer all my questions, and guide me through the process with so much professionalism and care.

johnPaulo.name: john paulo ebreo
johnPaulo.title: A true professional on a La Mer villa transaction
johnPaulo.text:
I worked alongside Dayan Candamil on the sale of a villa at La Mer, and she was a pleasure to deal with from start to finish. She knew the community and the product in detail, kept communication clear and fast, and handled every step, from viewings to paperwork and handover, with real care for the client.

Co-broke deals live or die on trust and responsiveness, and Dayan delivered on both.
